GOLEM-THE_GOLEM.title: The Golem
GOLEM-THE_GOLEM.description:
A slab of river clay and old boulders, given a stubborn spark of life.
Builds its body from [gold]Parts[/gold] as it climbs.
GOLEM-THE_GOLEM.aromaPrinciple: [sine][purple]Mud remembers every shape it has ever been...[/purple][/sine]
